caption: P01. Fantasy key image, creative proposal: a rolling salvage mech collects material above an inhabited green river canyon.

references.role: Verbatim approved style block embedded in prompt
Shared pillars, world/roster boundaries, production procedure
Accepted player fantasy and target systems

strengths: Battered irregular rolling mech with enclosed visible pilot and recognizable collector coil.
Magnetic fragments follow an intake path; wear is localized and substantial.
Large coherent sandstone canyon with green river vegetation, occupied terraces and working water infrastructure.
Natural light, concentrated electromagnetic accents and clear companion silhouette.
issues: Front three-quarter camera instead of the requested close third-person chase view.
Fresh internal fabrication and changed weapon brace are not separately legible; image demonstrates collection better than construction.
Companion signal does not visibly make contact with its intended priming target.
Some surface density and semi-realistic material rendering may need comparison with the chunkier sheets during cohesion review.
self_review.scope: Concept art only. Anonymous fox-like pilot does not select Sable or a character A/B/C direction. Hostile cutter is an unnamed mechanism proposal, not an approved boss. No regeneration performed.
